facts.text: Eat up, ladies, there is extra corn tonight. We need our strength for the big flight, and none of us is ending up in a pie.
facts.why: Not a Ginger line. Her famous line is 'We'll either die free chickens or we die trying.' This one is printed in quote marks and talks about extra corn and a big flight, which is not in her dialogue.
facts.fix: We'll either die free chickens or we die trying.

fix_note.text: We'll either die free chickens or we die trying.

facts.text: Serve the pies when Mrs Tweedy fires up the pie machine.
facts.why: Mr Tweedy finishes assembling the pie machine and runs a test with Ginger inside. Mrs Tweedy only orders it.
facts.fix: Serve the pies when Mr Tweedy runs the pie machine test.

facts.why: Ginger calls the escape meeting in hut 17, and the film keeps counting empty nests and falling egg numbers, so short again is fair.

vibe.verdict: A tidy prisoner-of-war canteen that suits the escape story, with good Tweedy pie jokes, but the look is a stock canteen and Ginger's best line is missing.
missing: Mrs Tweedy: 'Chickens go in, pies come out.' (the new pie machine)
Babs: 'I don't want to be a pie! I don't like gravy.' (the pie machine scare)
Rocky's chicken cannonball poster (Ginger finds it after he leaves)
Ginger's test run in the pie machine and the gravy explosion at the end
Nick and Fetcher's hat and tea set sales (the trading scene)
Rocky's morale dance party in the hut
ideas: Use the real Ginger line as the note: 'We'll either die free chickens or we die trying.'
Change Babs's house note to 'I don't want to be a pie! I don't like gravy.'
Swap the 'Egg Count Sheet' slip for a 'Mrs Tweedy's Pie Order' slip: 'Chickens go in, pies come out.'
Rename the 'Hot line' heading to 'Pie machine line' to keep the farm world.
